newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted on Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus four on Friday.
- Two barges, mid-Mississippi River, this week, bid at 112-1/2 percent of tariff, no offer or comparison.
- Two barges, Mississippi River (St. Paul through Savage), this week offered at a steady 140 percent, no bid.
- One barge, Illinois River (Hennepin), constructive placement by June 25, bid at 100 percent, no offer or comparison.
